caseName: Mothershed v. Oklahoma ex rel. Okla. Bar Ass'n
caseNameFull: George L. MOTHERSHED v. OKLAHOMA, ex rel. OKLAHOMA BAR ASSOCIATION

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to add an additional question to the petition for writ of certiorari denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied.
